runtimeSubstitutions.rule: Declared explicitly (2026-10-01) because carry_obligations.py's auto-derivation can never reach this step: it resolves origin steps by matching Transaction Type code, and step 1 and step 2 both use code '3', so step 2 is itself treated as an origin candidate and skipped. Appendix AE (p.722) says BUYPASS 'will identify the transactions as incremental based on the approval code that the merchant sends ... in the subsequent transactions' — the incremental leg must carry the estimated/initial leg's own response approval code.
